children: NBA star LeBron James said on X that he visited prediction market platform Polymarket’s headquarters and is set to partner with the company. According to Odaily, he posted a video showing several options displayed at Polymarket, including crypto, sports, economics, culture, weather and esports, and selected the sports button.

title: LeBron James Says He Visited Polymarket Headquarters Ahead of Partnership
